Commentary.Commentary: It looked like Pakistan would have been bundled out before 100, but Riaz's 24 off just 10 deliveries helped them get past it and post a fighting total. West Indie were great with the ball but leaked runs at the fag end. Sunil Narine was the pick of the bowlers as he finished with 4-0-22-3. Carlos Brathwaite too picked up 3 wickets. Their fielding was very poor, which cost them 20-25 runs more. Could this also cost them the match? Join us soon for the chase.

A superb cameo from Wahab Riaz at the end help Pakistan post a total of 132. After losing first wicket quickly, Babar Azam and Ahmed Shehzad added 41 runs for second wicket but didn't score it quickly. Then a mini-collapse didn't help their cause either. The experienced duo of Shoaib Malik and Sarfraz Ahmed tried to steady the ship but they too in process of scoring some quick runs lost their way.

OUT! PAKISTAN ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 132! Full length delivery on off, Ali drills it towards Brathwaite who collects it cleanly on his followthrough. Shadab Khan has already set off and runs towards the striker's end. Carlos goes across to the stumps at the bowler's end and flicks the bails off calmly.
Fullish delivery on off, hit hard to long off for a single.
HASAN ALI comes out to bat.
OUT! BRATHWAITE GETS HIS THIRD WICKET! Slower delivery outside off, Riaz goes for the slog but miscues it towards Holder at long on. This time he doesn't make any mistake.
SIX! That's hammered! Back of a length ball around off, Riaz backs away and slams it down the ground to clear the fence.
Slower delivery outside off, Khan goes for the paddle but gets a top edge due to lack of pace towards square leg. Single taken.
Yorker length ball around the leg stump, Khan looks to clip it but misses.
CARLOS BRATHWAITE to bowl the last over.
Short delivery on middle, Riaz mistimes his pull towards mid-wicket. Two runs taken. 16 from that over.
FOUR! Shot! On a length around off, Riaz slaps it over the bowler. Brathwaite from long off runs to his right and dives but fails to stop it going to the fence.
Fuller length ball on middle and off, Riaz slogs it through mid-wicket for a couple.

SIX! Another one goes down! Slower and on a fullish length on middle and leg, Riaz backs away and lofts it towards Holder at long on. He leaps to take it but lets it burst through his hands and the ball clears the fence.
On a length outside off, Khan taps it towards point for a single.
Slower one around off, slapped towards long off for a single.
FOUR! High full toss down  the leg side, Shadab manages to get bat to it and the ball races to the fine leg fence.

Slower delivery around off, Khan swipes it through square leg and they take a run. Decide to go for the second a touch late. Pollard gets across to his right, picks the ball quickly and fires a throw at the bowler's end but misses. Holder too fails to hold on to the ball and knocks the stumps with his hands. A chance goes begging. It was a great effort from Pollard.
Slower one from Holder, Riaz drives it to long off for a run.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.
Short of a length outside off, Riaz places it towards point and takes off. The fielder misses his shy at the striker's end. Had that hit, it would have been close. 100 up for Pakistan.
Fullish delivery outside off, tapped towards backward point for a single.
JASON HOLDER is back on.
Khan gets in line to the fuller delivery and nudges it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Shortish outside off, tapped towards point where the fielder misfields and the batsmen take a run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
WAHAB RIAZ is the new man in.

OUT! Superb take by Brathwaite! Good length delivery outside off, Wasim looks to go downtown but miscues it towards wide mid off. Brathwaite from mid off runs to his right and takes a brilliant diving catch. West Indies have been poor with their ground fielding but have taken some absolutely stunning catches.
Wasim missed out on that! Short and room on offer, Wasim goes for the cut but fails to get bat onto it.
FOUR! Good length delivery outside off, Wasim drags it down the ground and gets a boundary to his name.
KESRICK WILLIAMS comes back for a bowl.
SHADAB KHAN walks out to bat.

OUT! NARINE HAS WEAVED HIS MAGIC! Quicker and flatter delivery on middle and off, skidding through. Tanvir looks to defend it but misses and is pinged on the front pad. There is a huge shout for an lbw and the umpire obliges. Narine ends with the figures of 4-0-22-3.
FOUR! Good way to get off the mark! On the pads, Tanvir nudges it through fine leg for a boundary.
SOHAIL TANVIR strides out to bat.

OUT! Brilliant catch, Samuels! A touch short and flatter outside off, Ahmed rocks back and cuts it towards short third man. Samuels dives to his right and takes a really good catch. Pakistan are falling like a pack of cards!
Tossed up delivery, defended nicely off the front foot by Ahmed.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shortish outside off, cut towards point.
Bowling change as SUNIL NARINE comes back for his last over.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
IMAD WASIM walks out to bat.

OUT! BIG WICKET FOR WEST INDIES! Dug in short outside off, doesn't bounce that much. Malik pulls it uppishly towards Pollard at deep mid-wicket who pouches it safely near the fence. Brathwaite is absolutely pumped up and why not? They have been good with the ball today and are getting their rewards.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.

What is going on? West Indies have been poor on the field today. Back of a length ball on off, Ahmed punches it towards Holder at mid off who fumbles and parries it towards long on. Powell there makes a mess of it as he looks to pick it with one hand. Holder finally does the covering up. Two runs conceded.
Dug in short around off, Shoaib mistimes his pull towards mid-wicket for a single.
Wide! On a length, angling down leg, Malik looks to glance it but misses.

FOUR! This is poor fielding! On a length on middle, Malik dances down the track and drives it uppishly through mid off. Holder there dives to his right, gets his hands to it but lets it roll through to the fence.
CARLOS BRATHWAITE comes back into the attack.
Back of a length ball well outside off, Ahmed makes room and looks to punch it through covers but drags it back towards the bowler.
Brilliantly bowled! Yorker length ball on middle, Ahmed jams it down the track.
Short delivery around off, Malik controls his pull through square leg for a single.

Well played! Similar delivery outside off, Malik is successful in steering it to third man this time and takes a run. Turns back for the second and completes it with ease. The throw at the striker's end by Narine was wayward.
Slower delivery on a good length outside off, Shoaib looks to run it down to third man but misses.
Dug in short, Ahmed pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
JASON HOLDER is back on.
A touch short outside off, tapped towards third man for a single.
Tossed up on middle and off, turned towards mid-wicket for a single.
Ahmed sweeps this one towards fine leg for a single. It came off the glove.
FOUR! Well controlled! Shortish delivery outside off, Sarfraz rocks back and cuts it nicely behind point and the ball races to the fence.
Tossed up around middle and leg, Ahmed comes down and defends it to the leg side.
A touch short outside off, spinning in. Ahmed shapes to cut but misses.
SUNIL NARINE comes back for a bowl.
FOUR! Shot! Shortish delivery outside off, cut behind point for a boundary. 15 from that over.

BRILLIANT EFFORT BY BRATHWAITE! Fullish delivery outside off, Malik drives it towards the right of Carlos who picks it up and hurls in a throw at the striker's end but misses. The keeper half-stops it.
FOUR! Sloppy work, Lewis! Back of a length ball on off, Malik pulls it towards deep square leg. Lewis near the fence makes a mess of it and concedes a boundary.
SIX! That's crashed! Shortish delivery outside off, Malik stands tall and pulls it with authority over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Good game awareness! Back of a length ball outside off, Ahmed dabs it towards point and takes a sharp single. There was a shy by the fielder at the striker's end but misses.
CARLOS BRATHWAITE returns for a bowl.
Fullish delivery, Ahmed eases it to long on for a single and gets off the mark.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
SARFRAZ AHMED is the new man in.

OUT! ZAMAN FAILS TO IMPRESS ON HIS DEBUT! Tossed up outside off, Zaman looks to go for a full-blooded sweep but miscues it towards deep mid-wicket. Holder, runs to his right, judges it to perfection and takes a well-judged catch. West Indies are right on top and have kept the run-rate under check.
Fullish on middle and leg, nudged off the inner half towards square leg. Single taken.

Badree sees Zaman coming down the track and fires it around off. He dabs it towards point and looks for a single. His partner responds but seeing Simmons rush to the ball goes back. He misses his shy at the bowler's end and there is no one backing up. As a result, the batsmen take an overthrow.
Tossed up outside off, pushed off the front foot to mid off.
SAMUEL BADREE returns for a bowl.
Back of a length delivery outside off, cut through point for a single. Just 4 runs off the over!
Slower one, fuller on middle and off, Malik watches it carefully and eases it to long on for a single.
On a length, angling away, Zaman looks to play across the line. Gets a leading edge in the backward point region for a single.
Angling into the pads, worked in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Again on a length around off, defended off the back foot. 8 dot balls on the trot by Williams!
Length delivery, angling in, defended from within the crease.
KESRICK WILLIAMS is back on.
Full outside off, Zaman brings out his paddle sweep. Gets it fine down the leg side for a couple. First international runs for Zaman!
Defended off the back foot by the batsman
ALMOST A DRAG ON! Flatter one, sliding away, Zaman looks to punch it, gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball then ricochets just past the off pole.
FAKHAR ZAMAN, the debutant strides out to bat.

OUT! NARINE STRIKES! The pressure keeps on mounting on the visitors and they keep on crumbling under it. Served fuller on middle and leg, spinning away, Shehzad looks to clip it over mid-wicket but checks his shot. The ball lobs towards Brathwaite at short mid-wicket. He does really well to take it diving forward. Two set batsmen depart and Pakistan need to rebuild their innings now.
Shortish delivery around off, spinning in, Malik goes back and punches it. There's a misfield at extra cover and that allows the batsmen to take a single.
Served around middle and leg, played back to the bowler.
SUNIL NARINE comes back into the attack.
Pitched outside off, guided to third man for a single. 5 runs and a wicket in the over!
SHOAIB MALIK is the new man in.

OUT! BRATHWAITE STRIKES IN HIS FIRST OVER! Short of a good length outside off, Azam looks to punch it off the back foot. The ball however takes off from the deck, catches the outside edge and goes towards right of Walton. He hops to his right and grabs it head high, cleanly. Azam after getting a start has to walk back. Good start by West Indies, they are keeping it tight, building pressure on the visitors.
Deep mid-wicket comes in place.
On a length outside off, guided to third man for a single.
Bouncer outside off, Shehzad leaves it looking for a wide but doesn't get one.
Full outside off, driven to mid off. Powell the fielder there misfields and the batsmen take a couple. He has had a poor outing in the field today.
Length delivery, angling into the pads, tucked to deep square leg for a single.
CARLOS BRATHWAITE is into the attack now.
Flat and short outside off, Shehzad camps back to cut but fails to connect. Misses out on a loosener.
Shortish one outside off, punched through wide of extra cover for a single.
Shortish outside off, punched off the back foot to covers.
Shehzad skips down the track. Badree sees that and slips it down the leg side. Shehzad does well to adjust and clip it on the leg side for a single.
Fuller one on middle and leg, eased to long on for a single.
Full outside off, driven to long off for a single.
SAMUEL BADREE comes back on.
Shehzad gets to the pitch of the ball, clips it on the leg side for a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Short delivery, spinning away, cut through behind square on the off side for a boundary.
Spinning away from around middle and off, punched towards mid on.
Flatter through the air around middle, Azam looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Fuller one on the pads, clipped through backward square leg for a brace.
SUNIL NARINE is into the attack now.
Length delivery, angling in, clipped behind square on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Back of a length outside off, pulled over mid on. The ball goes one bounce into the stands. Safe shot to play in the Powerplay.
Mild shout for caught behind! Angling down leg, Azam shuffles and looks to tuck it but misses. The ball goes off the pads into the gloves of the keeper. Holder appeals but it's turned down.

FOUR! Pulled away! Poor fielding effort from Powell. Back of a length delivery, angling down leg, Azam pulls it over backward square leg. Powell the man in the deep, runs to his right, dives to stop the ball but fails.
Angling into the pads, flicked on the leg side.
Back of a length outside off, Shehzad works it through square leg for a single.
Change of ends for JASON HOLDER.
Short outside off, Azam mistimes his pull to mid-wicket. MAIDEN OVER BY WILLIAMS!
Length delivery outside off, dabbed towards point.
Shortish delivery outside off, tapped to covers.
Back of a length outside off, worked to mid-wicket.

Mild appeal for lbw! On a length around off, nips back in after pitching, Azam looks to play it across the line but misses. He is rapped on the pads and the ball goes in the backward point region. Williams start appealing but then pulls out of it.
Fuller length delivery outside off, worked to mid-wicket.
KESRICK WILLIAMS to bowl now.
Azam uses his feet, gets to the pitch of the ball and milks it to long on for a single.
Short around off, pulled through widish mid on for an easy single.
Badree drags his length back seeing Shehzad out of his crease. Shehzad does well to defend it on the leg side.
Flatter one around middle and off, defended down the track.
Full on leg pole, eased to long on for a single.
Fuller on leg, turned to short mid-wicket.
On the shorter side of a good length, placed in the gap in the mid-wicket region for a single.
On a length outside off, angling in, defended from within the crease.
Length delivery angling in, defended with soft hands in the mid-wicket region for a single.
FOUR! Slashed away! Short delivery outside off, Shehzad slaps it through backward point for a  boundary. There was width on offer and Shehzad latched onto it in a flash.
Fuller length delivery, Azam covers his stumps and clips it to deep square leg for a single.
Banged in short outside off, pulled to deep square leg for a single. Shehzad too gets off the mark.
JASON HOLDER to bowl from the other end.
FOUR! Great shot to release the pressure! Fuller one around off, Azam drives it off the front foot superbly. Finds the gap between mid off and covers for a boundary.
BABAR AZAM comes out to bat.

OUT! DREAM START BY BADREE! Akmal goes for a duck. Flatter through the air around middle and off, spins away just a touch. Kamran Akmal is lazy with his shot. Looks to guide it fine behind square on the off side but doesn't bother moving his feet. The ball whizzes past the outside edge and knocks the off pole. West Indies couldn't have asked for a better start.
Very full in the line of the stumps, driven back to the bowler.
Served around middle, skidding towards the pads, played with the angle on the leg side.
Sliding into the pads, defended on the leg side gently.
Full outside off, pushed to covers.

We are ready for action. The players and the umpires have come out in the middle. KAMRAN AKMAL and AHMED SHEHZAD to open the batting for Pakistan. SAMUEL BADREE to start off with the proceedings. Here we go...

Pakistan skipper, Sarfraz Ahmed says that it looks a good batting pitch. Reckons that 150-170 will be a good score. Mentions that last match they were complacent and will need to bat well. Feels that every T20 game is important. Adds that FAKHAR ZAMAN makes his international debut and Mohammad Hafeez misses out.

West Indies skipper, Carlos Braithwaite says that they are gonna field first. Adds that in the last 3-4 T20IS they have batted first but haven't done well. Mentions that whoever has the best 40 overs will come out on top today. Adds that hope they can progress today with the young leggie Shadab Khan and play him well.
Toss - WEST INDIES WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO FIELD.

PITCH REPORT - Rameez Raja having a look at the pitch says that it's a low-scoring pitch. Jeffrey Dujon adds that there's no grass on it and it's going going to be very classic, easy pitch to bat on. He also reckons that it will help the spinners and that's why it has been a traditionally low-scoring pitch.

Pakistan on the other hand have got the better of their opposition in the last 4 T20I games they have played. In the Gulf, they whitewashed them 3-0 and now won the first T20I at Bridgetown. Their team looks very good in this format of the game and will look to take an unassailable lead in the 4-match series today. Let's hope that the Men from the Caribbean bring their A game to the fore and give the visitors a tough fight.

Hello and a warm welcome to the 2nd T20I between West Indies and Pakistan. The visitors have taken a 1-0 lead courtesy of their 18-year old leggie, Shadab Khan. He was very impressive on his career debut and finished with figures of 4-0-7-3. The West Indian batsmen found hard to score off him and that led them to post a paltry total of 111 runs in 20 overs, which Pakistan chased with ease. The hosts are finding it hard to win at home. They have not won their last 9 International matches.
